data.description: Elegant Homes with Resort-Style Amenities | Sobha Solis
data.long_description:
Introducing Sobha Solis – a distinguished residential community by Sobha Realty, ideally located in the heart of Dubai’s dynamic Motor City. Thoughtfully crafted for those who value wellness, active living, and uncompromising luxury, Sobha Solis blends striking architecture with world-class amenities and a prime urban address.

-1, 1.5, 2 & 3-Bedroom Apartments
-Prime location in Motor City, with easy access to Al Qudra Road & Hessa Street
-Panoramic views of the Dubai skyline, Miracle Garden & Motor City Autodrome
-Fully-furnished options available with high-end finishes
-Spacious layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows and private balconies

World-Class Amenities:

Arsenal-branded gym & wellness center
Resort-style pools, sunken leisure areas & lap pool
Jogging track, rock climbing zone, dog park, BBQ areas
Outdoor cinema, Zen garden, parkour & more
Indoor racetrack viewing deck and sports bar

Fully-furnished options available (Sobha’s first offering in this format) with high‑quality finishes and superior craftsmanship.
